execution_order: Run node preflight.mjs --write and inspect PREFLIGHT.json.
Commit the immutable GO PREFLIGHT.json without changing any frozen package blob.
Only after the committed PREFLIGHT passes package-commit/blob/HEAD lineage validation, run node run.mjs --attempt 1.
Run node parse.mjs --attempt 1; do not overwrite RAW, CALL or CANDIDATE artifacts.
The primary lead reviews the candidate and decides whether the exact route is qualified.
stopping_rule: One transport-successful attempt is sufficient to test purity. Any route-purity or telemetry failure is INVALID and is not repaired by reference scoring. Harness or transport failure may be retried only in a new attempt directory after preserving prior artifacts.
next_gate: PRIMARY_LEAD_COMMIT_FROZEN_PACKAGE_THEN_NO_MODEL_PREFLIGHT; no model invocation is authorized by this frozen package alone.
